# CCV Research UI – AI Agent Guide

- **Architecture**: Two apps in one repo. Backend (Streamlit UI + FastAPI) lives in `backend/` with APC services; frontend Next.js 16 portal in `frontend/` with Hono-powered `/api`, Okta auth, and libsql/Drizzle persistence.
- **Local runs**: Backend Streamlit `cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && streamlit run app.py`; FastAPI `uvicorn api:app --reload`. Frontend `cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev` (or `build`/`start`). Frontend /api assumes `SESSION_JWT_SECRET`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_OKTA_*`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_POST_LOGOUT`, Azure model envs, and `DB_URL` (path to sqlite file joined then file-URLed in `lib/db.ts`).
- **LLM config**: Model maps in `backend/llm_wrapper.py` and `frontend/lib/llm.ts`; allowlist includes gpt-4.1*, gpt-5* variants, and `medgemma-27b-multimodal7` (custom URL, blank key). Set per-model endpoint/key envs (e.g., `AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY_GPT_5` / `_ENDPOINT_GPT_5`). Reject models not in `AVAILABLE_MODELS` on the frontend.
- **APC agentic flow**: Use `conduct_all_sections_research` / `conduct_section_research` in `backend/services/apc_orchestrator.py`; avoid legacy `conduct_comprehensive_research` except for maintenance. Section registry `SECTION_SERVICES` covers six sections; section 1 uses `analyze_code_descriptions` with cache.
- **Caching/output**: Section 1 caches JSON under `backend/output/services_findings/{cpt}/section_1_results.json` (toggle via `use_cache`). NCCI RAG retrieval outputs to `backend/ncci_rag/output/`; build indexes first via `backend/ncci_rag/src/build_*` scripts.
- **Critical data dependencies**: Place `backend/data/CPT Codes with Long Descriptions 2025.xlsx` before running. SQLite DBs auto-create under `backend/data/` via helpers in `backend/services/utils.py`; do not hardcode absolute paths.
- **NCCI RAG**: Pipeline in `backend/ncci_rag/src/retrieve.py` (range routing → policy expansion → BM25 + semantic RRF). Needs embedding envs (`AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY_EMBEDDING`, `AZURE_API_VERSION_EMBEDDING`, deployment/endpoint) and built BM25/Chroma/range indexes.
- **Frontend API contract**: Hono app mounted in `frontend/app/api/[[...route]]/route.ts`; protected routes registered in `_authRoutes.ts` so `obtainUserData` sets `c.var.user`. Session cookie (`aud=cotiviti-search-session`, HS256) issued by `lib/session.ts` during `/api/login` after Okta sign-in; logout clears it.
- **Data model & helpers**: Drizzle schema in `frontend/db/schemas.ts`; use `frontend/lib/db.ts` helpers to enforce user ownership and cascade deletes. `sessions.type` ∈ {chat, apc}; `sections` link to `chat`; `messages` store content/model/feedback; highlights in `highlighted_text`. Avoid direct SQL outside helpers.
- **Chat streaming pattern**: `/api/chat` pre-creates assistant row via `addToChatSessionMessage`, streams SSE `{type:"content"}` chunks then `{type:"messageId"}` after `updateChatMessageContent`. Preserve this shape if extending streaming.
- **Research creation (frontend)**: `createResearchSession` stores six section results; `createResearch` action/`/api/create-research` expect section payloads shaped like backend agentic outputs (string or structured dict for section 1). CPT lookup via `/api/cpt-codes` returning `cpt_codes_and_descriptions` (five entries).
- **UI conventions**: Streamlit styling defined in `backend/app.py` and `backend/views/utils.py` (white/black theme, bubble CSS)—keep selectors. Frontend uses Tailwind v4 + Radix; keep server-only modules (`lib/session.ts`, `lib/oktaServer.ts`) out of client components.
- **Prompting/formatting**: Legacy comprehensive flow parses XML-style `<SECTION_N><TITLE/><CONTENT/></SECTION_N>` and `<FINAL_ASSESSMENT>`; preserve tag format when touching prompts/parsers. Section 1 content replacement uses `replace_cpt_descriptions_in_text` to swap Excel descriptions—reuse to avoid hallucinated descriptions.
- **Testing & checks**: Backend smoke `python test_refactored_code.py` (imports/paths). Frontend lint `npm run lint`. Drizzle migrations: `npm run db:generate` then `npm run db:push` (drizzle-kit) if schema changes.
- **Stateful UX**: Streamlit workflow state keys: `apc_step`, `generated_cpts`, `selected_cpt`, `section_chat_history`, `session_id`. Frontend chat/APC navigation populated from `getUserChatHistory` (limits 40) into Zustand store `stores/userProfileSlice.ts`.

If any part is unclear or missing (e.g., RAG build steps, API contracts, new section wiring), ask for a deeper drill-down.
